original_ai_output.title_zh: 加纳2025年信贷查询中银行占比达86%
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 据加纳银行2025年信用报告，银行占2025年信贷查询总量的86%。移动货币贷款和工资贷款数量增加，解释了查询量持续上升的原因。该报道为单一来源。

key_facts.fact: 银行占2025年信贷查询总量的86%
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Banks accounted for 86% total enquiries for credit in 2025

key_facts.fact: 移动货币贷款和工资贷款增加导致查询量持续上升
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the increasing number of mobile money loans and payroll lending explains the continuous increase in enquiries

key_facts.fact: 2025年金融机构进行了超过2500万次信贷评估等查询
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Over 25m enquiries conducted by financial institutions for credit appraisals, others in 2025
